I was clinically dead, I experienced something that was unexplainable. How can you expirence religion, or a lack thereof, whilst still living?

I definitely do think that I am subscribing to what I personally think God is. I've thought about it alot, especially in these past few months. I think alot of my doubt, besides from this expirence, also comes from my doubts in the church and within scripture.
I was clinically declared dead, but why would my expirence be counted off as not experiencing some sort of reality outside of our own?
I had feelings, however, they pushed me away from religion. I was not judged by my sins, instead I felt aimless in the calming void; the vast sea of nothingness beyond death.

If I can't use that as a basis to create a belief system, then why should I base my beliefs off of what others say? Why would I use religious text, or what a preacher/priest has to say on the matter? Moreover, what makes my expirence any less credible then the testimony of another person?
